description: This file is a Perl module script for checking database integrity, schema consistency, relationships, and data validity within the Coocook project. It includes methods for schema comparison, relationship validation, and data checks specific to SQLite databases, with project-specific terminology such as 'coocook', 'schema', and 'dbck'.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Dbck
classes.description: A Perl module class for database consistency and integrity checks within the Coocook project.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a series of database integrity and consistency checks.

methods.name: check_schema
methods.description: Compares the live database schema with the code schema for discrepancies, specifically for SQLite.

methods.name: check_relationships
methods.description: Validates foreign key relationships and project ID consistency across related tables.

methods.name: check_sqlite_numeric_values
methods.description: Checks for empty string values in numeric columns and invalid number formats in SQLite tables.

methods.name: check_fc_values
methods.description: Detects duplicate organization/user names and verifies 'name_fc' fields match the 'fc' function output.

methods.name: check_url_name_values
methods.description: Verifies that 'url_name' and 'url_name_fc' fields match expected URL-safe formats based on project names.

methods.name: check_unit_conversions_values
methods.description: Checks for non-normalized unit conversion entries where 'unit1_id' > 'unit2_id'.

methods.name: _debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if debugging is enabled.
